translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Ome neg-sichigi-yolenai-daklesad Jesússe sesa-gusmalad
Degi Jesús Olivos-yarse nadsunnad.
Banedgine, waidaryala Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse gannar nonigu, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad. Jesús sigisgua, dulemar-odurdaksigusad.
Deun escribamar, degi, Fariseomar, ome-wargwen neg-sichigi-yolenai-galesad, Jesússe senonimalad. Dummagan dulemar-abargi ome-ogwisnonimargu,
Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, we-ome e-sui-sulid-ebo na neg-sichigi-yolenai gasmalad.
Emi Moisés anmarga igar-mesisad, omegan-degimalad akwagi makoye, oburgwegar. Degite, bedina, ¿igi be sogmosunna?
Ar yamo Jesús-wilubdakegala Fariseomar ese deyob egichismalad, adi Jesúsgi sorba gwisgumalagar. Ar Jesúsdi, napase dulluu atakdegu, e-gogi napa narmak-narmak imaksigisad.
Ar Fariseomar Jesús e-abinsaegala ese egisnanai-guarmarsoggu, Jesús gannar nue sigisgu, abin-sogded: —Ar bemar-wargwen na be iskuedsuli-itogele, a-inse akwa omegi metagodo.
Jesús gannar napase dulluu atakdebargu, gannar napagi narmaksigisbalid.

Ar Fariseomar degi-Jesús-soge itosmargu, mag na ulubgi e-iskudiid itosmarsoggu, wargwen-wargwen ainidmalad, dummagan-inse, geb degi a-sorba yaigana. Geb Jesús unnila ome-negabargi-gwichid-ebo bessunnad.
Jesús gannar nue sigisbargu, dakdegu, dulemar sate, unnila omebi gwichi, omega sogded: —Omegwa, ¿bia dulemar-begi-gwisgunanaid nadmala? ¿Wargwensaar be-odurdakye sogsasurmala?
Ome, abin-sogded: —Dummad, dule-wargwensaar angi gwisgussulid. Degi Jesús omega sogdemosun: —An begi gwisguosurmogad. Be nae, mer be bar iskuo.))
Jesús we-napneg-naidgi gwallu-meegwadyobid

Gannar Jesús dulemarga sunmakdebargu, sogded: —Ani an we-napneg-naid gwallu-meegwadid. Ar dule anba dagele, neg-sichidgi nanaosulid, gwallu-meegwad nikuoed, a-gwallu-meegwad burba-geg-bergued dulemarga uked.
Degi Fariseomar Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Be-ibmar-sogedi, na be dukin barsogsoggu, a-ular be-ibmar-sogedi, geg anmar abingaed.

Jesús, Fariseomar-abin sogded: —Ar an-ibmar-sogedi, na dukin an sog-inigwele, an-ibmar-soged napiragwad an soged, ar an wisid, bia an daniki, degine, bia an nabaloe. Ar bemardi wichurmalad, bia an daniki, degine, bia an nabaloe.
Ar bemardi unnila we-napneg-igar-maidba sogmalad, we dule-iskanaye, igi, we dule-nuedye. Andi an sogsulid we dule-iskanaye, igi, we dule-nuedye.
Ar dule-wargwengi an sogele, igar-naboegalad, we deyob an imaked andi napiragwadba soged, we dule-nuedye, igi, we dule-iskanaye, ar wargwen an sogsulid, an-Bab-an-barmialid, a-anbo soged.
Bemar-igar-maidgi sogmaid, dule-warbo barsoged-nikale, we napiragwadye abingalegoye.
Ani an-ibmar-sogedi, an na dukin angi an soged, degine, Bab-an-barmialid, angi sogmogad. Degisoggu, an-ibmar-sogedi napiragwaddo.
Degi Jesúsga sogdemarsun: —¿Bia be-Babde maisunna? Jesús, dulemar-abin sogded: —Aku be an-dakmalad, degine, an-Bab aku be dakmarbalid. Ar mag be an-dakmalana, an-Bab mag be dakmarmogando.
Weyob Jesús sunmaksa-gusad, deun Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, mani-weleged-naba-sii dulemar-odurdaksigu. Dule-wargwensaale gwen Jesús-gassurmalad, ar ade amba yo e-galeged-wilub omoged.
Jesús Judiomarga sogsad, an naedse geg be warmakmarye
Jesús gannar Judio-dummaganga sogdebalid: —An naesokar. Be an-amimalo-inigwele, be an-amimalosulid. Bemardi be-iskuedgi na be burgwemaloed. An-bia-naedse, geg bemar ase warmaked.
Degi Judio-dummagan sogdemar: —¿Ar ede na dukin oburgosi? Ar soged: ‘An-bia-naedse, geg bemar ase namarye.’
Jesús amarga sogded: —Bemar we-napnegginedid, andi nibnegginedid. Bemardi we-napnegginmaladid, andi we-napnegginedsulid.
A-ular an bemarga sogsa-gusmalad, be-iskuedgi na be burgwemaloye. Ar be an-abingasurmalale an doa, na be-iskuedgi be burgwemalodo.
Judio-dummagan Jesúsga sogdemarsun: —¿Ar be doa-sunna? Degi Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ar iduar bato an bega sogsamalad, an doa-dule.
Emi bemar-noar-nanadiidbali ibmar-bukidar an bemargi-soged nikad. Ar dule-an-barmialiddi napiragwadbi ibmar soged. Andi, an a-itosadba, we-napneggi-bukmaladga an sogdimogad.
Ar Judio-dummagan aku itosmalad deun Jesús sogsa-gusgu, an-barmialidye. E-Babgi ega sunmaked.

Degi Jesús sogdebar: —Ar ani Dule-Machi, bemar nakrusgi-biokegala niba an-onakwismalale, geb bemar wisgunonimaloed, an doa-dule, degine, an-itolegedba an ibmar-imakdisulid. Ar an-Bab an-odurdaksadba, deyob an sunmakdiid.
Ar an-Bab-an-barmialid anba gudiid, wargwen an-metedisulid, ar ade an bela-ibmar-imakedi, an-Bab-nabir-itogedi an imaked.
Jesús weyob sunmakedba, bukidar egi bensuli-gunonimalad.
Igar-napiragwad iskuedgi be-ollorsanonimaloed
Jesús Judiomar-egi-bengussurmaladga sogded: —Ar bemar an-gaya-burba-sunmakedgi nue eba nanaele, nue bemar an-sapingan-sunnadga gumaloed.
Degine, bemar igar-napiragwad wisgunonimaloed, degine, igar-napiragwad iskuedgi bemar-ollorsanonikoed.
Judiomar, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar Abraham-e-wagan gumalad, anmar aimar-maiga gwen gudisurmalad, degite, ¿ibiga be anmarga sogsunna: ‘Bemar ollorgunonikoye?’
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, dulemar-iskuedgi-gudimaladi, we-iskuedse mailedimalad.
Dule-maiga-arbaedi geg neg-yagi gudigu-sadeguad. Ar neg-ibed-e-mimmirdi neg-yagi gudigu-sadeguodo.
Degisoggu, ar Bab-Dummad-Machi iskuedgi be-onononikir, geb be nue-napiragwad ollorgumaloed.
An wisi bemar Abraham-wagan gumalad, degi-inigwele be an-oburgwebimalad, ar ade an-ibmar-sogsad be abingasurmalad.
An-ibmar-sogedi an-Bab-walik an ibmar-daksadba an sunmaked, ar bemardi be ibmar-imakedi be-bab-ibmar-itosadba be imakmarmogad.
Jesús Judio-dummaganga sogsa-gusad, nia-saila bemar-babye
Judio-dummagan Jesús-abinsadmargu, sogdemalad: —Abraham anmar-dadad. Jesús, abin-sogded: —Bemar Abraham-wagan-sunnadina Abraham-ibmar-imaksadyob bemar ibmar-imakdimarmoganad.
Ar Bab-Dummadgi-an-ibmar-napiragwad-itosad an a bemarga sogsad-ular, emigindi be an-oburgwebimalad. Dad-Abrahamdi gwen deyob gussulid.
Ar bemardi be-bab-Satanás-ibmar-imaked be imakmalad. Degi Judiomar Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Anmar dule-neg-sichigi-gwalulesad-surmalad. Anmar bab-nika-gwalulesmalad, Bab Dummad anmar-babad.
Degi Jesús amarga sogded: “Ar Bab Dummad bemar-babana, be an-sabmalando, ar Bab-Dummad-akar an danikid, degine, agi wese an nonikid. Ar na dukin an-itolegedgi an danisulid, Bab Dummad an-barmialid.
¿Ibiga nue-akusunna an-ibmar-soged be itomala? Ar ade an-ibmar-soged be itobisurmaladba, be aku itomalad.

Ar nia-saila bemar-babad, degine, be-bab-ibmar-abegedba be damalad. Ar gusgu, gebesailaunni nia-saila dule-gindakedid, degine, igar-napiragwadgi banguded, ar igar-napiragwad nia-sailagi naisulid. Ar nia-saila gakansaar sunmakdele, gusgu na e-daedba sunmaked, ar ade gusgu gakansaerbad, degine, dulemar-gakansaed-e-babad.
Ar andi ibmar-napiragwad sogsoggu, a-ulale be an-abingasurmalad.
“¿Ar doa-dule angi sogoe, an iskudiiye? Ar igar-napiragwad an sogele, degite, ¿ibiga be an-abingasurmarsunna?
Ar dule Bab Dummadgadile, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba sunmaked itoged. A-ulale, bemardi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-itosulid, ar bemar, Bab Dummadgadsulid.”
Cristo gwaluleged-idu bato gudigusad
Degi Judiomar Jesús-abinsadmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Ar anmar nabir sogmalad, be Samaria-dulemar-iskanayobmogad, degine, nia begi naid.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Nia angi naisulid. An-Bab-nug bur an odummodiid, bemardi an-nug-ichodimalad.
An na dukin nug-odummoged an amidisulid. Ar dule-wargwen an-nug-odummoged maid, a sogoed, an dule-nued-dibe, igi, an dule-iskana-dibe.
Napira an bemarga soged, an-gaya-burba-sogedba dule daele, we-dule burgosulid.

Degi Judiomar Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Emigindi anmar nue wisdo, nia begi naid. Abraham, degi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemaladdi burgwismalad, emide bedi soged: ‘Ar dule-wargwen an-gaya-burba-sogedba daele, burgwed itogosurye.’
¿Ar bede anmar-dad-Abrahamba bur dummasi? Ar dad-Abrahamdi burgwisad. ¡Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad burgwismarmogad! ¿Ar be doaye na sogsunna? ¿Ar be-bur amarba bur dummadsi?
Jesús, Judiomar-abin sogded: —Ar na dukin an na san-odummogele, an na san-odummogedi, binsaleddo. Bab Dummad bemar-Bab-Dummadye be sogmalad, a-Bab-Dummad an-Babad, a an-nug odummoged.

Bemardi a-Bab-Dummad-aku-dakmalad, andi a-Bab-Dummad-mag-daked. Ar bemarga an sog-dibe, a-Bab-Dummad aku an dakye, bemar-sunnaa an gakansasmogardo. Andi a-Bab-Dummad mag an daked, degine, e-gaya-burbaba an nanadibalid.
Anmar-dad-Abraham, an-danikoed-dakoedba weligwar itosad. An-nonikid daksagu, geb agi nue-weligwar itononisunnad.
Degi Judiomar ega sogdemalad: —Amba be birga-dulabo-gakambe niksulidde, ¿degite, Abraham be daksade? Be daksasuli.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, amba yo Abraham gwalulege, bato ani an gudiid.
Degi Judiomar akwa gadebinmalad, akwagi Jesús-makegar. Jesúsdi emar-idu dukusad, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi nodsunnad. Degi emar-abargi nodgu, nadsunnad.
